biotools.summary: MDockPeP2_VS is a structure-based in silico peptide screening program that integrates molecular docking with structural conservation to identify peptide inhibitors. It is written in python2.7 and uses AutoDock Vina, PCalign, and Naccess, and has been applied to develop peptide inhibitors against antibiotic resistance.
